evidence.title: Tracking evaluation inputs across runs
evidence.excerpt: Fictional sample. The link points to the real project release index.

analysis.what_changed: A fictional feature proposes storing an evaluation dataset fingerprint alongside metrics.
analysis.why_it_matters: It makes unexpected score changes easier to investigate.
analysis.application: Track a small evaluation dataset across two runs and note which rows changed.
analysis.limitations: A fingerprint identifies a dataset version and cannot reproduce the dataset by itself.

exercise: Spend five minutes choosing a small dataset, fifteen minutes comparing two query plans, and five minutes recording scan sizes and what changed.
takeaway: Keep the input and measurement method fixed when comparing tooling changes.
